content.json:
## TAM account health — early warning indicators
Every value is computed by the TAM saved functions in the selected workspace (`TAM_EWI()`, `TAM_Trend()`, `TAM_D_*()`). Thresholds come from the account's `TAM_EWIConfig` watchlist. Nothing here is typed by hand.

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.query:
summarize by subscriptionId
| project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), label = subscriptionId

content.query:
TAM_EWI()
| summarize Red = countif(State == "Red"), Amber = countif(State == "Amber"), Changed = countif(StateChanged),
            Gaps = countif(State == "No data"), Account = take_any(Account), Evaluated = max(EvaluatedAt)
| project Headline = strcat(Account, " — ", Red, " red · ", Amber, " amber · ", Changed, " changed since last week · ",
                            Gaps, " with no data · evaluated ", format_datetime(Evaluated, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), " UTC")

TAM_EWI()
| where IndicatorId in ("A01", "A02", "A06", "A08.P1", "B04", "B05")
| extend Tile = case(IndicatorId == "A01", "Agent health", IndicatorId == "A02", "Sources reporting",
                     IndicatorId == "A06", "Tuning backlog", IndicatorId == "A08.P1", "MTTR (P1)",
                     IndicatorId == "B04", "CSAT (rolling)", "Entitlement used"),
         Ord = case(IndicatorId == "A01", 1, IndicatorId == "A02", 2, IndicatorId == "A06", 3, IndicatorId == "A08.P1", 4, IndicatorId == "B04", 5, 6)
| project Tile, Display, Context, State, Ord
content.title: Key indicators

content.query:
TAM_EWI()
| summarize Indicators = count() by Family, FamilyOrder, State
| order by FamilyOrder asc
| project Family, State, Indicators
content.title: Indicator state by family

content.query:
TAM_Trend()
| where IndicatorId in ("A01", "A07")
| project Month, Indicator, Value
| order by Month asc
content.title: Six-month trend — the shape matters more than the level

content.query:
TAM_EWI()
| where State in ("Red", "Amber")
| order by StateRank desc, FamilyOrder asc, IndicatorId asc
| project State, Indicator, Reason, FirstMove, Was = PrevState
content.title: Needs a move today

content.json: Portfolio reads the daily snapshot table in every selected workspace, so it needs the snapshot Logic App running in each. Pick the workspaces with **Portfolio workspaces**.

content.query:
let lastSnap = TAM_EWISnapshot_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, State, Family, StateChanged) by Account, IndicatorId;
let counts = lastSnap
    | summarize Red = countif(State == "Red"), Amber = countif(State == "Amber"), NoData = countif(State == "No data"),
                Changed = countif(StateChanged), Snapshot = max(TimeGenerated) by Account;
lastSnap
| extend Rank = case(State == "Red", 3, State == "Amber", 2, State == "Green", 1, 0)
| summarize Worst = max(Rank) by Account, Family
| extend WorstState = case(Worst == 3, "Red", Worst == 2, "Amber", Worst == 1, "Green", "No data")
| project Account, Family, WorstState
| evaluate pivot(Family, take_any(WorstState))
| join kind=inner counts on Account
| project Account,
          Telemetry = tostring(column_ifexists("Telemetry", "")), Detection = tostring(column_ifexists("Detection", "")),
          Engagement = tostring(column_ifexists("Engagement", "")), Commercial = tostring(column_ifexists("Commercial", "")),
          Governance = tostring(column_ifexists("Governance", "")), Red, Amber, NoData, Changed, Snapshot
| order by Red desc, Amber desc
content.title: Worst state by family — latest snapshot per account

content.query:
TAM_EWISnapshot_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize LastSnapshot = max(TimeGenerated) by Account
| where LastSnapshot < ago(26h)
| project Account, LastSnapshot, HoursSince = round((now() - LastSnapshot) / 1h, 0)
content.title: Accounts with no snapshot in 26 hours

content.query:
TAM_EWISnapshot_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) and StateChanged == true
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Account, IndicatorId
| project Changed = TimeGenerated, Account, Indicator, Was = PrevState, State, Reason, FirstMove
| order by Changed desc
content.title: Changed since last week

content.query:
TAM_EWI()
| where Watchlist == "A"
| order by FamilyOrder asc, IndicatorId asc
| project IndicatorId, Indicator, Display, Context, State, Was = PrevState, AmberRule, RedRule, Reason, FirstMove, Source
content.title: Watchlist A — every indicator, this account

content.query:
TAM_EWI()
| where Watchlist in ("B", "Governance")
| order by FamilyOrder asc, IndicatorId asc
| project IndicatorId, Indicator, Display, Context, State, Was = PrevState, AmberRule, RedRule, Reason, FirstMove, Source
content.title: Watchlist B and governance — every indicator, this account

content.query: TAM_D_Devices()
content.title: EDR devices silent, impaired or never seen (A01)

content.query: TAM_D_Sources()
content.title: Contracted log sources — hours quiet (A02)

content.query:
let top8 = Usage | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and IsBillable | summarize GB = sum(Quantity) by DataType | top 8 by GB | project DataType;
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and IsBillable and DataType in (top8)
| summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1024.0, 2) by DataType, Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Day asc
content.title: Billable ingest per day, top 8 tables (A03)

content.query: TAM_D_Ingest()
content.title: Ingest drift per table vs 30-day baseline (A03)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (_LogOperation | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and Level in ("Error", "Warning")
     | project TimeGenerated, Kind = strcat("Ingestion: ", Category), Detail = strcat(Operation, " — ", Detail)),
    (Syslog | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and (SyslogMessage has "CEF:" or SyslogMessage has "LEEF:")
     | summarize TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count() by Computer
     | project TimeGenerated, Kind = "Parsing: CEF/LEEF unparsed in Syslog", Detail = strcat(Events, " events via ", Computer)),
    (SentinelHealth | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and SentinelResourceType has "Analytic" and Status != "Success"
     | project TimeGenerated, Kind = "Detection: rule run failed", Detail = strcat(SentinelResourceName, " — ", Description))
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Occurrences = count() by Kind, Detail
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Ingestion, parsing and rule-run failures in 24h (A04)

content.query: TAM_D_Coverage()
content.title: Threat profile coverage (A05)

content.query:
TAM_D_Noise()
| project Title, FalsePositive, Benign, TruePositive, NoisePct
content.title: Top 10 noise generators, 30 days (A06 tuning input)

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where ClosedTime >= startofmonth(now(), -5)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status, Classification, ClosedTime) by IncidentNumber
| where Status == "Closed" and Classification in ("TruePositive", "FalsePositive", "BenignPositive")
| summarize TPPct = round(100.0 * countif(Classification == "TruePositive") / count(), 1) by Month = startofmonth(ClosedTime)
| order by Month asc
content.title: True-positive rate by month (A07)

content.query:
TAM_D_Response()
| project Month, Priority, MedianRespondMin
| order by Month asc
content.title: Median time to respond by priority, minutes (A08)

content.query:
TAM_D_Response()
| project Month = format_datetime(Month, "yyyy-MM"), Priority, SLA, Incidents, MedianDetectMin, MedianRespondMin, P90RespondMin, SLAAttainPct
| order by Month desc, Priority asc
content.title: SLA attainment by month and priority (A08)

content.query: TAM_D_Vulns()
content.title: Critical exposures open past the amber age (A11)

parameters.name: Indicator
parameters.query:
TAM_EWI()
| order by FamilyOrder asc, IndicatorId asc
| project value = IndicatorId, label = strcat(IndicatorId, " · ", Indicator)

content.query:
TAM_History()
| where IndicatorId == "{Indicator}" and TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| summarize Value = avg(Value) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by Day asc
content.title: Daily value — {Indicator:label}

content.query:
TAM_History()
| where IndicatorId == "{Indicator}" and TimeGenerated > ago(180d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
| extend Prev = prev(State)
| where isempty(Prev) or State != Prev
| project Date = startofday(TimeGenerated), State, Was = Prev, Value
| order by Date desc
content.title: State changes — {Indicator:label}
